Name: Peskit's Hogwarts Express Train (CP)
Author: Azcari
Description:
[font=Tahoma][color=#dd7e6b][size=3][b][center]Have you ever wondered what the Hogwarts Express does when it is not used to transport all those kids to school?
Well now you know![/center][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[center]~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~[/center]

[font=Courier New]This one replaces the ol' grey train and the passenger wagons with versions inspired by the Hogwarts Express from Harry Potter. [/font]

[font=Courier New]If you are like me and never bother looking for the train but want to take a glimpse at it from time to time I recommend the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4473]Train Whistle Mod by Taskmaster2[/url]﻿.[/font]

[font=Courier New]For future updates I might edit the graffiti and the container contents to be more magical too. [/font]

[font=Courier New]Due to how the wheels are positioned and work I had to work around that.[/font]
[font=Courier New]The Mod was created after the SV 1.5 Update was released and should support all languages. It won't work with other Mods editing the train sprites as well.[/font]

[font=Courier New]I only upload on Nexusmods.com and do not approve of uploads on other sites without my permission.[/font]

[center]~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~[/center]
[font=Courier New]How to install:[/font]
[font=Courier New]You need Content Patcher and SMAPI for this to work.[/font]
[font=Courier New]1. Download[/font]
[font=Courier New]2. Unzip[/font]
[font=Courier New]3. Paste into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder[/font]

[center]~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~[/center][font=Courier New]
Check out my other mod:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7819]Wallpapers & Floor Retexture & Recolors[/url]


For everyone wondering why Yakul is there, the horse replacer is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/924]Rideable Deer from hojichas[/url][/font]
